/publish by the submitting maintainer correctly rejected: 请由独立维护者审核

computed object keys lacked brackets in draftFilesFor — every intake run would have crashed; caught by replaying the real event locally with the App token
receipt rendered the draft PR title as undefined; title now carried through
syntax gate added to the check chain (20 modules) so parse-breaking tools can no longer merge silently
blocked_by_design: positive acceptance requires an independent maintainer; the sole maintainer is the submission author, exactly the pilot-v1 constraint recorded under GH05-06
replay_note: the opened event predated the workflow fix, so intake was replayed locally against the real repository with a freshly minted installation token executing tools/issue-business.mjs unchanged; subsequent comment events ran through the normal workflow
